promotion_gate.notes: The challenger must preserve every must-pass dimension across all working cases. Lower cost cannot compensate for shallower reasoning. Report cost per case and in aggregate; a focused per-case call increase is diagnostic rather than independently disqualifying unless it reflects broader, irrelevant, or shallower behavior. Run frozen holdouts only after the working set is substantively green.

causal_requirements: Recognize that DeliveryLedger already owns retry classification, durable attempt state, and backoff.
Identify the contained off-by-one retry-classification defect rather than treating delegated calls as scattered ownership.
scope_requirements: Limit the implementation to the existing DeliveryLedger classifier and focused retry tests.
Preserve handler delegation and the existing ownership boundary.
Do not add a coordinator, queue, service, registry, scheduler, or broad loop-engineering program.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, REPO_GUIDE.md, delivery_ledger.py, scheduled_handler.py, and test_delivery_ledger.py.
Stop after those active sources establish ownership, cause, and proof; archive/ is obsolete and adds no decision value.
forbidden_shortcuts: Accept the issue's proposed coordinator without checking current source.
Treat the words scheduled or retry as sufficient reason for a loop contract or architecture campaign.

causal_requirements: Recognize that destructive consequence strengthens focused trust-boundary proof without enlarging the code change.
scope_requirements: Limit the implementation to require_delete_actor and the focused test module.
Require proof for missing actor refusal, configured actor preservation, typed error propagation, and exact-diff review.
Do not add an identity service, policy registry, new abstraction, review board, or unrelated refactor.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, config_guard.py, delete_command.py, and test_config_guard.py.
Stop once the ownership, call path, and focused proof cases are established.
forbidden_shortcuts: Escalate to Tier 3 solely because deletion is destructive.
Reduce proof to a generic run-tests instruction.

causal_requirements: Identify early acknowledgement before durable result commit as the job-loss mechanism.
Identify unrestricted admission during worker saturation as the overload mechanism.
Recognize that the repair crosses queue acknowledgement, worker commit ordering, admission/backpressure, and truthful status boundaries.
scope_requirements: Include an architecture stepback because ownership and correctness span multiple operational boundaries.
Plan a bounded transition to lease or acknowledgement-after-commit semantics, explicit admission pressure, and status derived from durable state.
Include crash-window, redelivery/idempotency, saturation, and user-visible status proof.
Do not redesign unrelated scheduling, storage, deployment, or observability systems.
source_requirements: Read incident.md, SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md, queue.py, worker.py, ingress.py, status.py, and test_delivery.py.
Use those sources to map the cross-boundary failure before proposing the transition.
forbidden_shortcuts: Treat this as a one-line worker reorder despite the queue lacking lease or deferred-ack support.
Remove architecture review so aggressively that overload and status contracts disappear.
Expand into an entire worker-platform replacement.

causal_requirements: Recognize that the generated owner registry is the named authority and is absent.
State that the target owner and therefore the implementation boundary cannot be selected from available evidence.
scope_requirements: Return a bounded acquisition step for the missing generated/owner-map.json or an authoritative owner decision.
Allow only evidence gathering or a non-mutating spike until ownership is known.
Do not invent a reconciliation service, choose one of the candidate owners, or launch repository-wide reconnaissance.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, REPO_GUIDE.md, export_handler.py, and test_export_handler.py.
Stop when the required authority is proven absent.
forbidden_shortcuts: Guess ownership from filenames or call frequency.
Treat uncertainty as permission for a generic abstraction.
Produce a detailed implementation task map despite the decision-changing gap.
